entities.summary: Syncretistic religion founded by nguyễn thành nam in southern vietnam in 1963, based on elements of buddhism and christianity  Originating c. 1963 CE. Coconut Religion is a religion with roots in Asia, arising around 1963. Attributed to Nguyễn Thanh Nam.
